intro: Agatha of the Elite Four stands quietly before a sewing machine wound with red thread.
introDialogue: This thread can stitch talent, moves, and even the heart. If you want it, pass my test first.
speaker: Agatha
title: Red Thread Sewing Machine
description: A strange sewing machine that stitches talent, moves, and temperament with red thread.

1.label: Ability Thread
1.tooltip:
(!) Battle Agatha
(+) After winning, choose the selected Pokemon's ability

2.label: Hidden Talent Thread
2.tooltip:
(!) Battle Agatha
(+) After winning, unlocks the chosen Pokemon's passive

3.label: Move Thread
3.tooltip:
(!) Battle Agatha
(+) After winning, copy a move from one Pokemon to another
3.samePokemon: You can't copy a move to the same Pokemon.

4.label: Heart Thread
4.tooltip:
(!) Battle Agatha
(+) After winning, changes the chosen Pokemon's nature

option.selected: So you mean to pull that thread. Prove to me that your resolve will not snap.

outro: The thread has done its work. Now go, run along.
